title: Price early BIT feedback for all 63 old packet-3410 readers
body:
## Mathematical result and scope

All five chart-421 rows are available after native clock 10388, before the original owner-221 feedback deadline. In these fixed diagnostic branches, even granting all five rows to chart 0 leaves the native Y3410 row outside its stock. One six-coordinate input witnesses all 32 tested payloads in each of four branches. The cheapest checked one-extra-receipt restoration in the fixed better branch is grade four, 268→0. That compiled control supplies the old row at all 63 readers, yet only 31 full reader values pass and there are 58 forward and 29 literal-adjoint output mismatches. Its signed full BIT margin is about −107.0727167934 at 0.00388.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8004 fc26105676ad6d2afb59e39fed08f602b7ba0b66 provides the related owner-restoration scope. The arbitrary recoding family in #8006 is not excluded by this fixed-diagnostic separator.

## Validation

Cold extraction passed all 29 hashes, four isolated python3 -I -B scripts, regenerated hashes, both operators, first-reader and 36/48 invoice checks. The same proof inventory retains a positive early-probe control.

## Open next questions

Change earlier old donor equations or a funded incidence. Preserve all old readouts and rebind the full word and finite application before admitting a gain.
